subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should OpenClaw accept current-run private transcript successful terminal turns as sufficient to recover a stale active subagent run as ok after this branch is rebased?
rationale: The code path changes lifecycle state and parent message delivery for a lost-context run; that boundary is a maintainer behavior choice, not just a mechanical test outcome.

options.title: Accept Private Transcript Boundary
options.body: Rebase and validate the PR while keeping recovery limited to the current run's private transcript with stop/end_turn terminal assistant turns.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Race Proof
options.body: Ask for a live Agent Teams or Gateway proof that reproduces the context-loss timing before approving the recovery predicate.

options.title: Choose A Different Terminal Signal
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want success recovery to depend on a different persisted lifecycle signal instead of transcript inspection.

recommendation.title: Accept Private Transcript Boundary
recommendation.body: Rebase and validate the PR while keeping recovery limited to the current run's private transcript with stop/end_turn terminal assistant turns.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc already articulated the canonical private transcript/status boundary on the related closed PR.
